layout_summary: A minimalist meme-style layout on a soft pale pink background featuring a red brand logo tab pinned to the top right. Below, a right-aligned blue iMessage chat bubble is followed on the left by a subhead and a horizontal row of three isolated coffee drink cutouts.

alignment_axes: e4 (left cup) and e2 (los planes:) align closely on the left around x=15.5%-16.5%
e4, e5, and e6 share a horizontal bottom baseline around y=74.0%-74.5%
whitespace: 30.5% open vertical space above the blue chat bubble
2.5% vertical gap between the blue chat bubble and 'los planes:'
8.5% vertical gap between 'los planes:' and the tallest drink cutout
25.5% empty margin below the bottom row of drinks

scene.subject: Three isolated beverages arranged side-by-side: an iced blended drink topped with whipped cream and caramel drizzle in a clear plastic cup, a dark brown ceramic mug filled with coffee and heart-shaped latte art, and an iced green matcha drink in a clear plastic cup.
scene.composition: Three distinct cutouts spaced evenly across the lower-middle horizontal axis, scaled to similar visual heights and grounded along a shared baseline.
scene.camera: Eye-level to slightly high-angle studio product photography, sharp focus throughout.
scene.lighting: Bright, even studio lighting with soft specular highlights on plastic cups and ceramic glaze.

elements.description: Iced caramel blended coffee drink with whipped cream and caramel drizzle in a clear branded cup.
Dark brown stoneware mug containing hot coffee with heart latte art.
Iced green matcha latte in a clear branded plastic cup.

ornaments.description: Small blue speech bubble tail extending from the bottom-right corner of the message pill.

why_it_works: High-contrast blue iMessage bubble immediately draws the eye as a familiar conversational hook.
Generous pale pink negative space keeps the punchline and three product cutouts clean and scannable.
Left-to-right reading flow naturally guides the viewer from the text setup down to the product lineup.
